We're trying to build a community of people who share their skills with one another to help create awesome group projects and stuff. Many of our members have, in the past, been part of projects that failed because either a key skill was missing (group of devs with no design experience, or some artists who can't create a website) so we're trying to help by making available a bunch of totally free resources.

  1. What's the catch? Do we have to show ads or anything? — Nope. When we say free, we mean it. No advertisements, no profit sharing (if you end up selling whatever you make), and you keep all intellectual property.

  2. How do you make money? — We don't. We're not a company, we're not funded by any corporation, we're a coworking group. Everyone here, the designers, developers, pm's, are all volunteers. We do accept donations, but we definitely aren't turning a profit (with a grand total of $5 donated so far).

  3. Can for-profit ventures, like studios or businesses get help? — Yes, but we require attribution for any free work we do. We do have paid options, albeit at a very reduced and affordable price, if you want to use our work without attribution.

Any other questions, feel free to PM me back or you can find our contact info on the website and someone will get back to you.

  2. How do you make money? — We don't. We're not a company, we're not funded by any corporation, we're a coworking group. Everyone here, the designers, developers, pm's, are all volunteers. We do accept donations, but we definitely aren't turning a profit (with a grand total of $5 donated so far).

  3. Can for-profit ventures, like studios or businesses get help? — Yes, but we require attribution for any free work we do. We do have paid options, albeit at a very reduced and affordable price, if you want to use our work without attribution.

Any other questions, feel free to PM me back or you can find our contact info on the website and someone will get back to you.
